body.summary: ReviewStreamError, ReviewStreamFailure and the review request types (ReviewStreamOpts, ReviewArtifactStreamParams, CodeReviewStreamParams, CodeReviewStreamResult) move from src/mcp/daemon-stream.ts to src/shared/review-stream.ts; daemon-stream.ts re-exports them, so its importers and the routing tests are unchanged. The first validate turn mapped a review-routing title that does not exist; this mapping uses real titles from both routing files.
